plan:
Final design delivered as a single document, 10 sections per the researcher's spec.

1. RQ + headline metric — QuaRot generalization to Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct; primary readouts are Δ_ppl and Δ_acc_macro vs C1; ratio r = Δ_noRot(W4) / Δ_quaRot(W4) paired against the same ratio on LLaMA-2-7B.

2. Experimental design — 6 primary cells (QuaRot-RTN/GPTQ × W4/W6/W8, W_A=8, g=128 symmetric, KV=FP16), 3 controls C1/C2/C3, 2 optional W4-KV4 cells. Single quarot_config.yaml pins every knob (no-retuning rule from A8).

3. Reference comparator — LLaMA-2-7B published numbers from neurips2024/94328/9. Sourcecapsule identifies the exact tables to extract (Table 2 for PPL, Tables 4–5 for zero-shot). Size mismatch acknowledged and explicitly discharged via the A9 delta-delta framing: the ratio r is sub-invariant under uniform additive quantization error.

4. Perplexity protocol — WikiText-2 raw, ctx=2048, stride=256, sliding window. Single deterministic number (PPL is eval-mode, no RNG); recorded with bit-exact re-run reproducibility check. PTB optional secondary, excluded from headline r.

5. Zero-shot protocol — lm-evaluation-harness with hf-causal, six benchmark signatures, 0-shot default with explicit exception: HellaSwag at 5-shot to match the paper's reported cell. U7 (ARC shot-count) flagged "to verify against the fact IDs before implementation" — 0-shot default, 2-shot only if the fact text says so.

6. Controls & sanity checks — C2 is a hard gate; failed C2 stops the sweep. C3 (QuaRot-RTN-W16) isolates the algorithm axis from the precision axis. Pre-flight order C1 → C2 → C3 → primary is recorded.

7. Analysis plan — fixed-threshold rubric for "matches LLaMA" (r ratio in [0.90, 1.10] with matching sign), "partial" (both deltas positive and Δ_quaRot ≤ Δ_noRot), "fails" (Δ_quaRot > Δ_noRot or r_Phi-3 < 0.5 while r_LLaMA-2 > 1.0). No post-hoc threshold adjustment. Algorithm comparison: sign of Δ_RTN − Δ_GPTQ across bit-widths.

8. Feasibility & environment — explicit single A100-80GB target. Per-cell runtime table given (~75–100 min). Total budget ≤ 24 GPU-hours. U1 (Phi-3 adapter in QuaRot) named as the largest implementation risk and the only place Phi-3-specific code enters the pipeline.

9. Threats to validity — table of U1–U7 each with a one-line mitigation: U2 embedding/output-head symmetry verification against live config; U3 ctx=2048 design closes this; U4 KV4 comparator cell identified as W4A8KV4 with a sourcecapsule; U5 mechanism-robustness framing if r falls in the Partial band; U6 documented as a limitation not a workaround; U7 default assumptions stated with contingency.

10. Deliverables — D1 11-row cell summary, D2 control-panel mini-table, F1 PPL curve, F2 per-task zero-shot bar chart, F3 r-vs-LLaMA ratio bar chart; companion configs and LOG.jsonl files specified.

No empirical numbers fabricated. Tense and scope are design-only throughout. U1 (Phi-3 adapter in QuaRot) and U7 (ARC and HellaSwag shot-counts in QuaRot's published comparator cells) are named as the two open resolution points before any execution would start.
